        distances = pdist(points)

        if len(distances) == 0:
            return 0

        max_dist = np.max(distances)

            return 0
            
        return -min_dist / max_dist

    points_fib = points_fib / np.maximum(norms, 1e-10) * 0.95

    points_fib += np.random.normal(0, 0.035, points_fib.shape)

            coord_idx1 = (i-4) % 3
            coord_idx2 = (i-4+1) % 3
            point[coord_idx1] = 0.5
            point[coord_idx2] = 0.5
            additional_points.append(point)

        points_de += np.random.normal(0, 0.003, points_de.shape)

        ("differential_evolution", points_de)
